title: USF Evidence Envelope Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for the common evidence envelope across evidence kinds (rank-4 runtime-proof-evidence). Each envelope declares its evidence kind (evidence-kinds) and, conditionally: runtime-proof-evidence requires providerMode, environment, and freshness; validation-evidence requires freshness and at least one of sourceRefs/evidenceRefs; a generated-report requires evidenceRefs and freshness and may not be treated as raw evidence; normalised-evidence requires sourceRefs to the raw evidence it reshapes. Governs the ontology concepts Evidence and Generated Report. GOVERNANCE ENVELOPE: instances MUST carry id, title, description, authorityLevel, lifecycleState, ontologyConcepts, taxonomyRefs, vocabularyRefs, and aiGuidance (schema-authoring-standard section 9/11); kind (artefact-kinds) and version are deviated/deferred (recorded per section 9.3). Overclaim and missing-evidence fail-closed cross-record checks remain validator-deferred. lifecycleState draft; not active.

authorityLevel.$comment: authority-levels value pinned to the registry authorityRole.

allOf.$comment: Runtime proof evidence is provider- and environment-dependent and must be freshness-pinned.
Validation evidence must be freshness-pinned and reference what it summarises.
A generated-report envelope must reference the underlying evidence and be freshness-pinned (Authority Model section 2.7).
Normalised evidence must retain a reference to the raw evidence it reshapes.
